globalParameters.name: Backup node count
globalParameters.description: How many nodes with a Node role of "Unassigned" will have the role of "Backup"?

globalParameters.name: Multicast address
globalParameters.description: IPv4 multicast UDP address used for inter-node communication (state propagation).

constraint.errorMessage: Must be an ipv4 address: ###.###.###.### (each number from 0 to 255).

globalParameters.name: Multicast port
globalParameters.description: Multicast UDP port used for inter-node communication (state propagation).

globalParameters.name: Target frame rate
globalParameters.description: Target frame per seconds at which the cluster should run.  Set to 0 for unlimited.

globalParameters.name: Delay repeaters
globalParameters.description: Delay rendering of repeaters by one frame, to be used when repeaters depends on state computed during the frame processing of the emitter.  Increases latency of the system by one frame.

globalParameters.name: Headless emitter
globalParameters.description: Disables rendering of the emitter (headless).

globalParameters.name: Replace headless emitter
globalParameters.description: Will shift NodeId used for rendering of repeater nodes (RenderNodeId = NodeId - 1) when used with a headless emitter.

globalParameters.name: Handshake timeout (seconds)
globalParameters.description: Timeout for a starting node to perform handshake with the other nodes during cluster startup.

globalParameters.name: Communication timeout (seconds)
globalParameters.description: Timeout for communication once the cluster is started.

globalParameters.name: Enable hardware synchronization
globalParameters.description: Does the cluster tries to use hardware synchronization?

globalParameters.name: Capsule port
globalParameters.description: Port opened by the process running alongside the cluster display executable listening for instructions while running.  It will be incremented by 1 for every LaunchPad after the first in the same LaunchComplex.

globalParameters.name: Delete registry key
globalParameters.description: Does the setup of the cluster node deletes the registry key produced by a previous execution?  Especially useful to clear display settings of the previously running version of theapplication.

globalParameters.name: X
globalParameters.description: Number of horizontal displays.

globalParameters.name: Y
globalParameters.description: Number of vertical displays.

globalParameters.name: X
globalParameters.description: Physical width of a display (not to be confused with screen size in pixels).

globalParameters.name: Y
globalParameters.description: Physical height of a display (not to be confused with screen size in pixels).

globalParameters.name: X
globalParameters.description: Physical width of display bezels.

globalParameters.name: Y
globalParameters.description: Physical height of display bezels.

globalParameters.name: Position Windows
globalParameters.description: Position non fullscreen windows to match layout of physical screens represented by windows.

globalParameters.name: Show Test Pattern
globalParameters.description: Show the test pattern instead of rendering the game.

launchPadParameters.name: Node identifier
launchPadParameters.description: Unique identifier among the nodes of the cluster, keep default value for an automatic assignment based on the order of the launchpad in the launch configuration (-1 for automatic assignment).

launchPadParameters.name: Node role
launchPadParameters.description: Role of the node in the cluster.  One node is to be configured as the Emitter while the other ones should be configured as a Repeater.

launchPadParameters.name: Multicast adapter name
launchPadParameters.description: Network adapter name (or ip) identifying the network adapter to use for inter-node communication (state propagation).  Default adapter defined in the launchpad's configuration will be used if not specified.
